entities.summary:
Vivid Entertainment, founded in 1984 and headquartered in Los Angeles, is a pivotal player in the global adult entertainment industry. Established by Steven Hirsch, this American adult film studio has significantly influenced cultural perceptions of sexuality and adult media, making it one of the most recognizable brands in the field. Vivid's productions often feature high-profile celebrities, which not only popularized the genre but also raised discussions regarding the intersection of celebrity culture and adult entertainment.

Over the years, Vivid Entertainment gained notoriety for its innovative approach, including the production of adult films featuring mainstream stars and the introduction of high-quality video formats. The studio became a household name with the release of notable films and series, including the infamous 'Kim Kardashian, Superstar' in 2007, which marked a turning point in the relationship between mainstream media and adult entertainment. Vivid has also been at the forefront of the digital revolution, adapting to new technologies such as streaming and online distribution, which enabled broader access to adult content and reshaped consumption patterns.

The legacy of Vivid Entertainment is profound, influencing not only the adult film industry but also societal attitudes toward sex and pornography. Its impact is evident in the way adult content is integrated into mainstream media and the normalization of previously taboo subjects. Vivid has also played a role in legal discussions regarding adult content, copyright issues, and the rights of performers, shaping policies that affect the industry today. As Steven Hirsch stated, 'We are in the sex business, but we also are in the business of creating new forms of entertainment.'
